decisions.reason: Removing Aave yield does not change the automatic prize payout or winner-announcement behavior.
Chainlink VRF winner selection remains valid independently of whether prize-pool deposits earn Aave yield.
The Aave removal does not alter Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, or reset rules.
The Aave removal does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, carryover, or reset rules.
Removing the yield integration does not change the Big Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, or sale-based pool funding.
Removing the yield integration does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, or sale-based pool funding.
Primary-mint proceeds can continue funding the prize pools without those deposits generating Aave yield.
The necessary same-message MODIFY already removes the Aave technology entry and yield-generation feature copy; no additional or corrected state change is needed.
Secondary royalties can continue funding prize pools even though the accumulated funds no longer earn Aave yield.
The direct referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and automatic payout are independent of Aave yield.
The Transak fiat conversion and mint flow is unrelated to the removed Aave prize-pool integration.
Brevo transactional email delivery is unrelated to the removed Aave prize-pool integration.
